opening.argument: The video promotes a purported front-running bot as a route to substantial passive income, directing viewers to fund a contract and activate it for trading. It says, "the more you put in, the larger transaction you'll be able to front run,. And the more profit you'll be able to make," while describing a higher-gas transaction that places the viewer’s trade ahead of another and produces a profit. It further reports, "usually I make four plus Ethereum a week." Although the speaker acknowledges that the activity is not always profitable, the funding instructions and claimed returns establish the promotional character of the offer. The available material does not establish that the contract worked as described or that viewers lost funds.
